findings.rootCause: Equipment skill ops acquire + draw(amountField) are valid in equip.skill, but the old unchanged onPlay synthesis violates the field-anchored effect / v2 mixture restriction. The old path marked used before validation, so neither insertion nor draw occurred and the once-per-battle charge was lost.
